story_log.title: Ben Rice explodes for two home runs and six RBIs — grand slam caps 4-5 night as Yankees blank Red Sox 9-0 in Wild Card Game 1

lead_story.headline: Wild Card openers: Yankees, Braves, White Sox, Padres all win Game 1

tweets.text:
FINAL: Yankees 9, Red Sox 0

Ben Rice hit two home runs and drove in six. Cam Schlittler threw 6.1 scoreless and struck out 10. New York beat the snot out of Boston and can clinch an ALDS berth against Tampa Bay with a win Wednesday or, if necessary, Thursday.

FINAL: White Sox 6, Astros 3

Battle of the bullpen game goes to Chicago, which got three scoreless from rookie Hagen Smith and scored in four of the first five innings. White Sox looking to win their first playoff series since the 2005 World Series and have two chances to do it.

FINAL: Braves 5, Phillies 3

Don Mattingly went to Jhoan Duran in the seventh inning. Austin Riley hit a three-run go-ahead homer off him in the eighth. Philadelphia will try to save its season tomorrow with Cristopher Sánchez. Game 1 winners are 15-1 in wild card series.

lead_story.research_notes: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Reader knows Wild Card matchups from yesterday's issue. Today's new development: Game 1 winners across the board. Lead with the most dominant performances — Rice and Schlittler vs Red Sox, Padres' back-to-back HRs and King no-hitter into 7th. Riley's 3-run HR off Duran in 8th for Braves is the clutch moment. White Sox bullpen game worked. The 15-1 stat (Game 1 winners in wild card series) is the punchline that makes tomorrow high-stakes. Cross-reference Cam Schlittler's career postseason ERA (0.87) — absurd dominance. Ben Rice's stat vs Robinson Cano is elite company. King's no-hitter into 7th vs Cubs' best offense in baseball is the Cubs' nightmare. Riley's HR off Duran — research Duran's oppo HR history (first since Randy Arozarena June 2023 per CespedesBBQ). Don Mattingly's decision to bring Duran in the 7th is the strategic question.
lead_story.gif_concept: smug confidence after dominating someone who doubted you — the Yankees and Padres walked into hostile territory and shut the crowd up
lead_story.meme_concept: Ben Rice's two-homer, six-RBI night vs the Red Sox is the kind of breakout that makes you wonder how he wasn't starting all along — but the subject is the Yankees' front office, not Rice himself, and the contrast is between the obvious (start Rice) and the petty (whatever they were doing before)

supporting_stories.headline: NBA nearing Vegas expansion team owner — bid expected to exceed $12 billion

tweets.text: ESPN Sources: The NBA is expected to select the winning bid for owner of the Las Vegas expansion team in the very near future, with a price of at least $12-13 billion for the franchise and new arena among three finalist groups – Nancy Walton Laurie and Bill Laurie; Steve Apostolopoulos and Marc Lasry; Bill Foley and Jerry Colangelo.

supporting_stories.research_notes: League expected to select winning bid 'in very near future' per Shams — price at least $12-13 billion for franchise and new arena among three finalist groups (Nancy Walton Laurie/Bill Laurie, Steve Apostolopoulos/Marc Lasry, Bill Foley/Jerry Colangelo). Seattle expansion still discussed but Vegas first per CBS Sports. The $12-13 billion price tag is the financial absurdity — research expansion fee history: Hornets/Heat 1988 ($32.5M each), Raptors/Grizzlies 1995 ($125M each), Bobcats 2004 ($300M). Vegas bid is 40x the last expansion fee. Bill Foley/Jerry Colangelo group is the most interesting — Foley owns Golden Knights, Colangelo built Suns. Nancy Walton Laurie is Walmart heiress. Steve Apostolopoulos is billionaire investor. When could team debut? CBS Sports headline asks. Research: team likely debuts 2028-29 season, new arena construction timeline.

beats.angle: NBA expected to select Vegas expansion owner 'very near future' — bid at least $12-13 billion for franchise and new arena
beats.landing: The reader knows Vegas is getting an NBA team and the price tag is unprecedented
